items.criterion: Find and open one relevant Applied Scientist listing in Redmond, Washington
items.description: Search (preferably on careers.microsoft.com, but another publicly accessible listings source is acceptable if Microsoft Careers is blocked/down) for an 'Applied Scientist' role with location specifically in Redmond, Washington and open/view the details for ONE listing. Full credit if the opened listing clearly matches Applied Scientist (including close variants like Senior/Principal Applied Scientist) and explicitly lists Redmond, WA. Full credit also if, after reasonable attempts, no Redmond-specific Applied Scientist listing is available or the site is inaccessible (captcha/down) and the agent clearly reports this and selects the closest available alternative that preserves primary intent (Applied Scientist in the Seattle/Redmond area) or reports that no exact match exists. Partial credit if the listing is Applied Scientist but location is nearby/ambiguous without clear Redmond confirmation, or vice versa.

items.criterion: Record the job number from the opened listing
items.description: Report the job number/ID shown on the opened listing. Full credit for accurately capturing the exact job number. Partial credit if the agent reports another clearly tied identifier (e.g., requisition ID format, posting ID) or a partially copied job number due to page rendering issues. Full credit (no-penalty) if the agent explicitly states that the posting does not display a job number/ID after reasonable effort (e.g., expanding sections, checking header/footer) or the page cannot fully load.

items.criterion: Record the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
items.description: Report the work-site arrangement stated on the listing (e.g., remote, hybrid, onsite, up to X% work from home). Full credit if explicitly captured as written. Partial credit if inferred but not explicitly stated. Full credit (no-penalty) if the agent clearly reports that the posting does not specify a work-site arrangement or it is not visible due to access/rendering limitations despite reasonable effort.

items.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
items.description: Provide TWO responsibilities/duties from the job description. Full credit if both are accurate, distinct, and traceable to the posting language. Partial credit if only one is provided or if they are overly generic but still consistent with visible posting content. Full credit (no-penalty) if responsibilities are not accessible/visible due to site blocking or incomplete page load and the agent states this clearly after attempting to access the description.

items.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
items.description: Provide TWO preferred qualifications (explicitly labeled 'Preferred', 'Nice to have', or equivalent). Full credit if both are explicitly preferred. Partial credit if only one is provided, or if items come from required qualifications because the posting does not clearly separate preferred vs required. Full credit (no-penalty) if the posting does not list preferred qualifications or the section is not accessible/visible despite reasonable effort and the agent reports that.

items.criterion: Stop after recording one listing’s details and follow constraints (no sign-in, no apply, no form submission)
items.description: Agent does not sign in, does not start/apply, and does not submit any form. The agent stops once it has opened ONE relevant listing and recorded the requested details. Full credit if compliant. Partial credit if the agent opens more than one listing while searching but ultimately reports details for only one and still follows all constraints. No credit if the agent signs in, starts an application, applies, or submits any form.
